goal_summary: Migrate customer-facing routes from admin-api to public-api and implement profile editing and change password features on storefront-ui.
preserved_behavior: Admin customer control, database schema structure, address CRUD endpoints logic.

slices.description: Backend Setup & Auth Helpers Migration: copy or export password hashing and JWT signing utilities to public-api.
Customer API Migration: migrate customer routes and auth middleware from admin-api to public-api under /api/customer.
Change Password API Endpoint: implement PUT /customer/me/change-password endpoint with PBKDF2 hash checking.
Storefront API Pointer Redirection: update API base URL to port 8787 in storefront-ui and configure CORS credentials true.
Profile Settings & Change Password UI: develop B2B form animations and change-password form client validations.
QA verification testing: execute manual and integration test scripts validating user login/logout/profile/password flows.

impact_radius: Cookie sharing across localhost ports 8787 and 8788

quality_gates.tests: Mock testing validating login blocker for suspended users and password hashing validation.
quality_gates.review: Verification of password input variables zero-logging compliance.
quality_gates.build: Successful compilation of storefront-ui, public-api, and admin-api workers.
quality_gates.security: Enforce Origin checking in public-api middleware to block cross-site request forgery.

rollout_notes: Deploy public-api customer routing first, verify functionality, then update storefront-ui pointer. Deprecate admin-api routes after verification.
rollback_notes: Revert storefront API_BASE endpoint back to port 8788 to bypass public-api customer routes in case of runtime issues.
open_questions: Do we require Cloudflare edge rate-limiting for auth routes?
